description: PCM1804 is a 24-bit, 192-kHz stereo delta-sigma A/D converter with fully differential ±2.5 V analog inputs, a linear-phase antialias decimation filter and a high-pass filter. It outputs PCM (left-justified, I2S, standard 24-bit) or 1-bit DSD data. It runs as master or slave from a 5 V analog supply and a 3.3 V digital supply.

groups.description: Two supplies: VCC (5 V analog) and VDD (3.3 V digital). VCC minus VDD must stay below 3 V.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: AGND, AGNDL, AGNDR (analog) and DGND (digital). All grounds must stay within ±0.1 V of each other.
groups.name: GROUND

groups.description: Differential analog inputs for each channel, plus the reference (VREF) and common-mode (VCOM, 2.5 V) outputs, which need external decoupling.
groups.name: ADC

groups.description: Serial audio interface: BCK, LRCK and DATA in PCM mode. In DSD mode these pins become DSDL, DSDBCK and DSDR. Clock pins are outputs in master mode and inputs in slave mode.
groups.name: AUDIO

groups.description: Pin-strapped configuration: data format (FMT0/1), oversampling ratio (OSR0-2), slave/master (S/~M), HPF bypass (BYPAS) and active-low reset (~RST). Most have internal 51 kΩ pulldowns.
groups.name: CONTROL

groups.description: SCKI system clock input, 128 to 768 fS.
groups.name: TIMING

groups.description: Per-channel overflow flags OVFL and OVFR, PCM mode only.
groups.name: ALERT

pins.name: VREFL

pins.description: Analog ground for the VREFL reference.
pins.name: AGNDL

pins.name: VCOML

pins.name: VINL+

pins.name: VINL-

pins.name: OSR0

pins.name: OSR2

pins.description: System clock input: 128, 256, 384, 512 or 768 fS (8.192 to 36.864 MHz). Schmitt-trigger input, 5 V tolerant.

variants.notes: The datasheet lists only the 28-pin SSOP (DB) package. Body dimensions are typical JEDEC DB SSOP-28 values and were not checked against the mechanical drawing. The DBR (tape and reel) suffix is assumed, not confirmed.
